regions.caption_as_printed: Reading left to right: W. J. Jewell; Edward Fitzpatrick, county president of the A. O. H. and grand marshal of the parade; James J. Murphy, state organizer; Judge J. A. Lynch, chairman of the St. Patrick's day committee; James J. Connolly, secretary of committee, and Rev. Father James O'Brien, prefect of section No. 1, A. O. H.
regions.description: A group photograph of six men posed together, some seated and some standing, dressed in formal early 20th-century attire including suits and clerical collar. The image appears to be a halftone portrait grouping associated with St. Patrick's Day celebration leadership.
